{{Color|Legendary}} |contains = 7 |music-1 = [[File:Tower Defense Simulator - Vigilante Crate|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Bring justice to Cyber City!|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Vigilante Crate''' is a crate purchasable for {{Coins|3,500}}. You can also buy the Vigilante Skin Bundle [[Gamepasses|gamepass]], which will give you all six skins that you can claim through the [[Gift Box]]. This crate yields six futuristic skins, which also are themed around Japan. Skins from this crate can appear in the [[Daily Store#Daily Skin Store|Daily Skin Store]]. Each skin that can be obtained from the '''Vigilante Crate''' has a rarity which affects how likely you are to unlock the skin and the price when it appears in the Daily Skin Store. In the Daily Skin Store, {{Color|Common}} skins cost {{Coins|99,999}}, {{Color|Uncommon}} skins cost {{Coins|4,000}}, {{Color|Rare}} skins cost {{Coins|5,000}} and {{Color|Legendary}} skins cost {{Coins|7,000}}. The '''Vigilante Crate''' is a grey and white crate with some parts being colored orange. A kitsune emblem can be seen on the front of the '''Vigilante Crate'''. It is opened using a black and yellow card. ==Skins== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:VigilantePyromancerIcon.png|175px]] |[[File:VigilanteElectroshockerIcon.png|175px]] |[[File:VigilanteShotgunner0.png|175px]] |[[File:VigilanteMortarIcon.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} |{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} |{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} |{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Uncommon}} |{{Color|Uncommon}} |{{Color|Rare}} |{{Color|Rare}} |- !Cost |{{Coins|4,000}} |{{Coins|4,000}} |{{Coins|5,000}} |{{Coins|5,000}} |- !Tower |[[Pyromancer]] |[[Electroshocker]] |[[Shotgunner]] |[[Mortar]] |- ! |[[File:VigilanteCommanderIcon.png|175px]] |[[File:VigilanteAcceleratorIcon.png|175px]] |[[File:VigilanteGladiatorRework0.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} |{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} |{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Rare}} |{{Color|Legendary}} |{{Color|Legendary}} |- !Cost |{{Coins|5,000}} |{{Coins|7,000}} |{{Coins|7,000}} |- !Tower |[[Commander]] |[[Accelerator]] |[[Gladiator]] |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} VigilanteThumbnail.png|'''Vigilante Crate''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VigilanteCrateKey.png|Key used to open the '''Vigilante Crate'''. }} ==Trivia== *The description of the '''Vigilante Crate''' suggests that the skins from this crate combat crime in [[Cyber City]]. *There were three different sets of {{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} skins, two of which were never added into the game. **The first skin set was a [https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/615753550626291717/795954703712256050 skin submission] from the Tower Defense Simulator Discord, which also had a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8O7LSPV13bQ promotional video] made for it. Their appearance can be found [https://imgur.com/a/ADE7gtM here]. **The second skin set was made by the developers. These skins were based on the skin submission. While these were never released, a trailer was made for them, which can be found [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rF6z_T187OE here]. Max level appearance of each of these skins can be found on the tower's gallery pages. **The third skin set is the one currently in the game. Unlike the other two skin sets, the red color present on them was changed to orange. *For less than a day, the '''Vigilante Crate''' advertisement in the home section of the store started working again, however, rather than selling its bundle it actually sold a minies character gamepass to a game called chwyle9's Place. **It only had a cost of {{Robux|10}} but it did absolutely nothing in Tower Defense Simulator if bought. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''24 June 2023''' -
